paper_metadata.title: Deformation mechanisms and remarkable strain hardening in a lightweight high-temperature eutectic high-entropy alloy

evidence.quote: In this work, Al1.0CrVNix (x = 1.3, 1.5, 1.7, 2.0 and 2.5) and AlyCrVNi1.5 (y = 0.75, 1.25, 1.3, 1.37 and 1.5) LWHEA systems with low densities of 5.6 – 6.6 g cm 3, have been proposed.
The XRD patterns of the Al1.0CrVNix and AlyCrVNi1.5 LWHEAs (hereinafter called Al1.0Nix and AlyNi1.5) are shown in Fig. 1 .
For Al y Ni 1.5 LWHEAs, the Al 1.37 Ni 1.5 (E) ingot exhibits a smooth and shiny surface
The compressive stress-strain curves of Al1.0Nix and AlyNi1.5 at room temperature are shown in Fig. 6
the high temperature σsys of the Al1.37Ni1.5(E) and Al1.5Ni1.5 alloys compared with the other alloys
a series of Al1.0CrVNix and AlyCrVNi1.5 eutectic LWHEAs with low densities (5.6 – 6.6 g cm3) and excellent room- and high-temperature mechanical properties are developed.
With increasing Ni content and Al content, two complete eutectic microstructural transitions with hypoeutectic to hypereutectic of Al1.0CrVNix and AlyCrVNi1.5 systems are obtained.
